transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. We're at the production lock stage for The Last Orchard presentation on October 18 at the Calder Cinema. Before I can approve the final plan, I need to ask our rights and music leads to report any confirmed changes to the draft. So, starting with rights — do we have any confirmed changes to report regarding the digital cinema package, the two public screenings, audience photography, or the standard courtesy credit? And then music — any confirmed changes to the commissioned score, the 10-player ensemble, or the 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM rehearsal?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report several confirmed changes based on the revised license email I received this morning from the Orchard Estate. The license permits exactly one public screening — not two. It requires 35mm projection, not a digital cinema package. It prohibits any audience or house recording, so audience photography is not allowed. And the required credit line is specifically 'Courtesy of Orchard Estate,' not a standard courtesy credit. I have not yet uploaded the email to the shared production packet, but these are the confirmed terms.
